title: OS and Playground Language Support
description: Add compile-time-checked internationalization (English + German) to the OS shell (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx) and playground (framework/product/os/dev). Extend the existing typed i18n system in ui/js/react/index.tsx (UiTranslationSchema, UiLocale, satisfies-guarded bundles) with missing shell keys, add a ui.chrome.locale localStorage setting, and add a Language dropdown to the OS Settings panel with English/Deutsch options.
summary: Extended the existing compile-time-checked i18n system in ui/js/react/index.tsx (UiTranslationSchema, UiLocale, satisfies-guarded en/de bundles) with the missing shell keys (settings language/app fields, display save/layouts/unavailable, common name/save), added a `ui.chrome.locale` localStorage helper pair matching the theme/compact/expertise pattern, added an AssertUiSettingsLanguageKeysCovered compile-time coverage check, and wired the browser language detector to prefer that key without double-caching. Wired framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx (both the OS shell and the playground boot through it) to consume the schema via a new non-hook `shellLabel` helper: added a Language dropdown (English/Deutsch) to the Settings panel, persisted/reactive uiLocale state, and translated the Settings, Display, Search and Find panel copy. Also fixed a pre-existing compile error where the bundles used an untyped `fullscreen` key missing from the schema. Verified with tsc (no new errors vs baseline, full diff saved in ticket folder), vitest for both packages (69/69 renderer-react pass; ui-react's 9 pre-existing unrelated failures are jsdom/PointerEvent and tree-rendering issues, not caused by this change), and end-to-end in the running playground (port 6070): switching Settings → Language to Deutsch instantly retranslates the whole shell chrome (navbar panel toggles, Settings/Display panels, Search/Find dialogs), and the choice persists across reload via localStorage `ui.chrome.locale`.
